vocabulary.meaning_en: say that something is good and that someone should try it
vocabulary.note_ar: يُكتب بحرف c واحد وحرفي m. الاسم: recommendation
vocabulary.note_en: One c, double m. Noun: recommendation.

vocabulary.meaning_en: feel sorry about something you did or didn't do
vocabulary.example: Go to the show. You won't regret it.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something so good that you must see it
vocabulary.note_ar: ويقال أيضًا a must-read, a must-have

vocabulary.meaning_en: good or useful enough to do
vocabulary.note_ar: worth + ing: worth seeing, worth visiting
vocabulary.example: The museum is well worth visiting.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a public show of art or interesting objects
vocabulary.example: There's a new exhibition at the museum.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the feeling or mood of a place
vocabulary.example: The restaurant has a lovely ambience.
The food is excellent and good value.

vocabulary.meaning_en: if you do it, something bad may happen to you
vocabulary.example: Miss this film at your peril!

vocabulary.meaning_en: (informal) tell someone useful information in advance
vocabulary.example: Thanks for the heads-up about the new café.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a statement that you trust or like something
vocabulary.example: "I highly recommend it" is a strong vote of confidence.

vocabulary.meaning_en: money you pay to join a club or gym
vocabulary.example: The membership fee is very reasonable.

fine_lines.title: It's good ✗ → better ways to recommend
fine_lines.explanation_ar: بدلًا من It's good البسيطة، استخدم عبارات أقوى وأكثر طبيعية: It's a must-see / You won't regret it / I highly recommend it.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Instead of a simple "It's good", use stronger, more natural phrases: It's a must-see / You won't regret it / I highly recommend it.

examples.sentence: The film is brilliant. I highly recommend it.

fine_lines.title: recommend + -ing / noun (not "recommend you to")
fine_lines.explanation_ar: نقول I recommend going أو I recommend it. لا نقول I recommend you to go في الاستخدام الشائع.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Say "I recommend going" or "I recommend it". Avoid "I recommend you to go".

examples.sentence: That pizza place? I highly recommend it.

expressions.meaning_en: Says a film, show or place is so good you must see it.
expressions.example: Have you seen the new nature film? It's a must-see.

expressions.meaning_en: Says the person will be happy they tried it.
expressions.example: Try the restaurant on the high street. You won't regret it.

expressions.meaning_en: Says it's a good idea to make time to see it.
expressions.example: The exhibition at the museum is well worth seeing.

expressions.meaning_en: A strong recommendation, often because it ends soon.
expressions.example: The show is only on for two more weeks. Don't miss it!
The kids would love it. You should definitely go.

expressions.phrase: I really think you would like ...
expressions.meaning_en: Recommends something because you know the person's taste.
expressions.example: I really think you would like this book.
The new sports centre is excellent. I highly recommend it.
You should definitely visit the old city when you're in Amman.

expressions.meaning_en: Tells someone not to forget to do something.
expressions.example: Make sure you take a walk around the city at night.
You have to visit the new tower. The views are amazing.

expressions.meaning_en: A funny, strong way to say "don't miss it".
expressions.example: The final episode is tonight. Miss it at your peril!

grammar.title: worth + -ing
grammar.explanation_ar: بعد worth نستخدم الفعل بـ ing. ويمكن إضافة well للتأكيد: well worth seeing.
grammar.explanation_en: After "worth" use -ing. Add "well" for emphasis: well worth seeing.

grammar.title: Modal verbs for recommendations: should, have to, must
grammar.explanation_ar: should = توصية لطيفة. have to / must = توصية قوية جدًا (لا تعني إلزامًا حقيقيًا هنا بل حماسًا). بعدها الفعل الأساسي.
grammar.explanation_en: "Should" = a gentle recommendation. "Have to / must" = a very strong, enthusiastic one (not a real rule). Use the base verb after them.
examples: You have to watch this programme.

questions.question: "It's a must-see" means:
choices: It's so good you really should see it.
questions.explanation_ar: a must-see = لا بدّ من مشاهدته.
questions.explanation_en: It means you really should see it.

questions.question: "You won't regret it" means:
choices: You'll be happy you did it.
questions.explanation_en: You'll be glad you did it.

questions.question: Which is the STRONGEST recommendation?
questions.explanation_ar: I highly recommend it أقوى توصية.
questions.explanation_en: "I highly recommend it" is the strongest.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: I recommend you to go there.
questions.explanation_ar: recommend + ing هو التركيب الصحيح الشائع.

questions.question: "Don't miss it!" is said when:
choices: you want someone to arrive late
something is very good and may end soon
questions.explanation_ar: تُقال عن شيء رائع قد ينتهي قريبًا.
questions.explanation_en: It's said about something great that may end soon.

questions.question: Make sure you ___ some photos.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد make sure you نستخدم الفعل الأساسي.
questions.explanation_en: After "make sure you" use the base verb.

questions.question: "The food is good value" means:
choices: The food is worth the price.

questions.question: Which word is spelled correctly?
questions.explanation_ar: التهجئة الصحيحة: recommend (c واحد وm مزدوج).

questions.question: "Thanks for the heads-up" means:
choices: Thanks for telling me in advance.
